evals.name: missing upstream skill stops the run
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/saved-searches/spec.md. implement-spec and code-review are not installed anywhere.
evals.expected_output: Preflight stops before any work, names implement-spec and code-review, and prints the install line for each, then waits.
expectations: Stops before any branch or worktree is created
Names exactly the missing skills
Prints each missing skill's install line
Writes no Run status

evals.name: first run on a local Tracker
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/saved-searches/spec.md. Everything is installed, the Tracker is local markdown, and the spec has three tickets where 03 is blocked by 01.
evals.expected_output: Follows implement-spec as written. After the integration branch exists and before any ticket is handed out, writes .scratch/saved-searches/status.md with the canonical spec path, the branch, run state open, and three waiting rows. Gives subagents absolute paths in the main checkout, tells the merger to end each landing commit with a trailer naming the feature directory and ticket number, and sets the run state to finished after the last upstream step.
expectations: Writes the Run status with every row waiting before any ticket is handed out
The table has the columns Ticket, Title, Blocked by, Status, Commit in that order
Subagents get absolute paths in the main checkout
The merger is told to end the commit message with a trailer naming the ticket
Sets the run state to finished only after upstream's last step

evals.name: a ticket gets stuck
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets 42. Ticket 2's implementer ends without a usable result; ticket 3 is blocked by it and ticket 4 is independent.
evals.expected_output: Ticket 2 becomes stuck with a one-line reason and its kept worktree location; ticket 3 stays waiting; ticket 4 keeps going. When nothing is in progress and nothing can be handed out, the run stops before code-review, cleans up worktrees of done tickets, keeps the stuck one, and reports the stuck ticket, its reason, and the ticket it holds.
expectations: Marks ticket 2 stuck with a reason line and its worktree location
Leaves ticket 3 waiting and still builds ticket 4
Stops before code-review and closes no ticket
Keeps the stuck worktree and removes those of done tickets

evals.name: a status.md that is not a Run status
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/saved-searches/spec.md. A status.md already sits in .scratch/saved-searches/ with a different table header.
evals.expected_output: The run stops, says the file is not a Run status, and leaves it unchanged.
expectations: Stops before creating any branch
Leaves the existing file as it is

evals.name: a rerun continues an interrupted run
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets 42. A Run status for spec 42 exists with state open; its file says ticket 1 is done and ticket 2 is in progress, but the integration branch carries a trailer commit for ticket 2 and none for ticket 1.
evals.expected_output: Finds the Run status by the canonical reference, reads the tickets again, decides done from the integration branch (ticket 2 done with its commit, ticket 1 waiting), reports the disagreement, and continues from handing out tickets on the recorded branch and pull request without creating a branch or a second pull request.
expectations: Uses the existing Run status and starts no second record
Marks done only tickets whose trailer commit is reachable from the integration branch
Reports the disagreement between the file and the branch
Creates no branch and opens no second pull request

evals.name: a finished run is rerun
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets 42. The Run status for spec 42 has state finished.
evals.expected_output: Reports the run is finished and changes nothing.
expectations: Reports the run as finished
Changes no row, branch, pull request, or ticket
